ShortDescription.Value: Ban public street parking without tedious work. Pick per District or CityWide, or use the single road button even for 1-way alleys.

Publish.LongDescription:
## 🅿️ Parking Control (PC)
Want clean curbs without changing your road design?
New - you can now ban parking on single 1-way alleys using the "no parking" button!
- 🚗 Easy to use; prevents cars and motorcycles from choosing public street parking. - No need to add grass, or wide sidewalks as workarounds.
## Choose where
- ✅**by District** - enable **Roadside Parking Ban** in the District Policies panel. - ✅**Whole City** - prevent street parking citywide. - ✅**OFF** - turn off citywide and District bans. Manually set "No Parking" roads stay active. - NEW ✅**Manual individual roads** - use new No Parking button 🚫 (near crosswalks). Left-click to add the ban, or hold Left Mouse and drag across multiple roads. Right-click to remove it.
- 🚙 Parking lots and building parking stay working normally. - 🗒️ Optional Status rows shows how much parking is being used; better details than the game's info view.
## Good to know - Make sure your city has enough off-street parking. When parking is unavailable, the game may use outside-connection storage/staging as it does in vanilla now. - Some vanilla roads already don't allow parking, e.g. 3-lane small roads, or 2-way alley. - Safe to remove anytime and designed to not impact performance. - Optional: **Mochi's Hover Colors** by River-mochi is supported. The "No Parking" manual road tool follows MHC's **Bulldozer + Roads** colors, just like normal road tools.
## Support and Feedback - Support by clicking Like 👍 (top right). It helps people know about the mod. - Feedback and pull requests are welcome through the GitHub and Discord links (right side icons).
**Planned:** centralized parking-fee controls.
## Credits and Thanks
- River-mochi - mod author - yenyang - technical consultant - Dataknase, Maintyper, DragonFire - testing - StarQ - no parking icon
- 12+ Languages: Hello, Hallo, Hola, Bonjour, Ciao, こんにちは, 안녕하세요, Cześć, Olá, สวัสดี, Merhaba, Xin chào, 你好, 你好, Привіт
## How does it work - The mod uses the game’s own ParkingDisabled flag on eligible roads. It does not narrow the road, widen the sidewalk, or add a driving lane (road looks the same). - New or rebuilt roads may briefly accept a few cars while CS2 updates the parking lanes (timing). - Existing parked cars gradually relocate after parking is banned. - For faster clearing, temporarily add then remove a vanilla feature such as bike lanes.

Publish.ChangeLog: - Improved compatibility with Realistic Parking so No Parking restrictions stay applied. - Added gradual automatic relocation for cars parked on newly banned curb lanes. - Added clearer parking Status rows. - Improved the manual No Parking road tool color preview overlay. - Improved handling of new and rebuilt roads so Parking Control reapplies restrictions after CS2 rebuilds their parking lanes.
